camel_example: aliyun polardbx DescribeActiveOperationTasks --region cn-hangzhou --Status '-1' --AllowCancel '-1' --PageSize 25 --PageNumber 1 --AllowChange '-1' --TaskType all --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --ProductId polarx --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InsName 'pxc-xxxxx' --DbType polarx --ChangeLevel all
description_en: Queries O&M events by calling the DescribeActiveOperationTasks operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeActiveOperationTasks接口获取运维事件
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx describe-active-operation-tasks --biz-region cn-hangzhou --task-type all --product-id polarx --db-type polarx --ins-name pxc-xxxxx --change-level all --page-size 25 --page-number 1 --status -1 --allow-change -1 --allow-cancel -1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeActiveOperationTasks

parameters.help_en: The task type. A value of all indicates that all tasks of the user are queried. Set this parameter to all
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型，all代表查询该用户下所有的任务，固定取值为all
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The product name. Default value: polarx
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The database type. Set this parameter to polarx
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The instance name. Default value: empty string
parameters.help_zh: 实例名，默认为空字符串
parameters.name: ins_name

parameters.help_en:
The change level. Default value: all. Valid values:

- **all**: All levels of exception recovery and system O&M.
- **S0**: Exception recovery.
- **S1**: System O&M
parameters.help_zh:
变更级别，默认all：

- **all**：选择全部异常修复和系统运维的级别
- **S0**：异常修复
- **S1**：系统运维
parameters.name: change_level

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 25
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数, 默认每页25条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

- **-1**: All pending and running tasks.  
- **3**: Pending. 
- **4**: Running
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，取值：

- **-1**：选择全部待执行和执行中的任务  
- **3**：待执行 
- **4**：执行中
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the time can be modified. Valid values:

- **-1**: The time of all O&M events can be modified.
- **0**: Not allowed. 
- **1**: Allowed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许修改时间，取值：

- **-1**：允许修改全部运维事件的时间
- **0**：不允许 
- **1**：允许
parameters.name: allow_change

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether cancellation is allowed. Valid values:
- **-1**: All O&M events can be canceled.
- **0**: Not allowed. 
- **1**: Allowed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许取消，取值：
- **-1**：允许取消全部运维事件
- **0**：不允许 
- **1**：允许
parameters.name: allow_cancel
